phase_name: Defense Layer — OFI Linear Filter + WindowShield Integration

files_created.description: Cont et al. (2014) Order Flow Imbalance with EWMA smoothing and z-score thresholds. 4 pressure levels: NORMAL/CAUTION/HIGH/EXTREME. Deterministic, zero-heap.
key_methods: on_book_update(bid_vol, ask_vol, bid_vol_prev, ask_vol_prev, best_bid, best_bid_prev, best_ask, best_ask_prev, ts_ms)

files_modified.description: Added OfiPressure enum, ofi_pressure_ member, and CLOSE_ONLY override when OFI pressure is EXTREME. update() now accepts optional OfiPressure parameter (default NORMAL).
changes: Added ofi_pressure_ member to WindowShield class
update() now accepts OfiPressure parameter, forces CLOSE_ONLY on EXTREME

integration_notes: When OfiPressure::EXTREME, WindowShield::update() forces ShieldState::CLOSE_ONLY regardless of time-in-window. Pressure level is stored in ShieldStateInfo::ofi_pressure for strategy layer consumption. WindowShield snapshot now includes ofi_pressure field.
